Ten years ago, keeping bees in the middle of a city would have been {{1}} as a harmless eccentricity. Today, rooftop hives are a common sight above offices, hotels and even department stores. Urban beekeepers {{2}} that city bees often do better than their country cousins, which are exposed to pesticides and to vast fields that offer food for only a few weeks a year. Parks, gardens and tree-lined streets, by contrast, provide flowers from early spring until late autumn.

The hobby is not, however, without its difficulties. A new colony needs constant attention, and beginners frequently {{3}} the amount of time it takes. Those who persevere are rewarded not only with honey but with a deeper understanding of the natural world. Meanwhile, experts warn that the sudden rise in hive numbers may {{6}} the supply of flowers, leaving wild pollinators with too little to eat. items.explicacion: "Dismissed as" significa descartar algo considerándolo poco importante. "Overlooked" y "neglected" no se construyen con "as" con este sentido, y "refused" no admite "as".
"Maintain that" = sostener que. "Remark" no va con "that" tras un sujeto así en este contexto de opinión sostenida, "imagine" es suponer y "persuade" necesita un objeto (persuade somebody).
"Underestimate the amount of time" = calcular por debajo. "Undervalue" se refiere al valor, "underline" es subrayar y "undermine" es socavar.

"Protect something against the cold/disease" es la construcción natural. "Defend" y "guard" implican un ataque activo y se usan con "from"/"against" un enemigo; "shelter" se usa con "from" y no con "against disease".
"Come to notice" = llegar a darse cuenta de algo. "Observe" no se usa con "come to" en este sentido, "attend" es asistir y "regard" necesita "as".
"Outstrip the supply" = superar, ir más deprisa que la oferta. "Outgrow" es quedarse pequeño, "outlast" es durar más que y "outweigh" se usa con ventajas y desventajas.
"Impose limits" = establecer límites. "Enforce" es hacer cumplir algo ya existente, "oblige" se usa con personas e "insist" necesita "on".
"Scour the city for" = rastrear buscando. "Scrub" es fregar, "scrape" es raspar y "scatter" es esparcir; ninguno se combina con "for nectar".
